title: Lesson 57 · Can I help you, madam?
titleZh: 第57课 您要买什么，夫人？

examples.en: A woman in jeans stood at the window.
examples.zh: 一位穿牛仔裤的女士站在橱窗前。

examples.en: The assistant who served her was very rude.
examples.zh: 接待她的店员非常无礼。

examples.en: She decided to punish the assistant.
She was dressed in a fur coat.
The assistant was eager to serve her this time.
examples.zh: 这次店员很殷勤地接待她。

examples.en: She stood at the window of an expensive shop.
examples.zh: 她站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。

examples.en: She asked to see a dress in the window.
examples.zh: 她要求看看橱窗里的一条连衣裙。

examples.en: She returned to the shop the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上她又来到这家商店。

examples.en: He climbed into the shop window.
She sought out the rude assistant.
examples.zh: 她找到了那个无礼的店员。

examples.en: With great difficulty, he got the dress.
examples.zh: 他费了好大的劲才拿到那条连衣裙。

sentences.en: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
sentences.zh: 一位穿着牛仔裤的女士站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。

sentences.en: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
sentences.zh: 女士生气地走出商店，决定第二天惩罚这个店员。

sentences.en: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
sentences.zh: 他费了好大的劲爬进橱窗去取那条连衣裙。

sentences.en: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
sentences.zh: 女士一看到这条裙子，就说她不喜欢。

sentences.en: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
sentences.zh: 他轻蔑地看了她一眼，告诉她那条裙子已经卖出去了。

article.en: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
article.zh: 一位穿着牛仔裤的女士站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。

article.en: Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
article.zh: 虽然她犹豫了一会儿，但最终还是走了进去，要求看看橱窗里的一条连衣裙。

article.en: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
article.zh: 接待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着。

article.en: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
article.zh: 他轻蔑地看了她一眼，告诉她那条裙子已经卖出去了。

article.en: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
article.zh: 女士生气地走出商店，决定第二天惩罚这个店员。

article.en: She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
article.zh: 第二天早上，她穿着裘皮大衣，一手拎着手提包，一手拿着长柄伞，又来到这家商店。

article.en: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
article.zh: 店员没有认出她是谁，这一次很殷勤地接待她。

article.en: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
article.zh: 他费了好大的劲爬进橱窗去取那条连衣裙。

article.en: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
article.zh: 女士一看到这条裙子，就说她不喜欢。

article.en: She made the assistant bring almost everything in the window before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
article.zh: 她让店员几乎把橱窗里的东西都拿了出来，最后才买下她最初要的那条连衣裙。
